name: Mental Arithmetic Drills
description: Build the mental arithmetic habits that keep a two-minute score climbing.

lessonNames.l10-known-decimals: Fractions you should know as decimals

lessonObjectives.l1-left-to-right: Add two-digit numbers left to right in your head.
lessonObjectives.l2-round-and-adjust: Add and subtract by rounding to a ten and correcting.
lessonObjectives.l3-making-100: Use complements to 100 for fast subtraction and change.
lessonObjectives.l4-running-total: Hold a running total across a chain of additions and subtractions.
lessonObjectives.l5-tables: Recall every product up to 12 by 12 without counting up.
lessonObjectives.l6-splitting: Multiply a two-digit number by a one-digit number by splitting it.
lessonObjectives.l7-near-round: Multiply numbers near 10, 50 or 100 by compensating.
lessonObjectives.l9-missing-multiplication: Divide by asking which number multiplies up to the target.
lessonObjectives.l10-known-decimals: Recall the decimal forms of common fractions, and derive the rest from them.
lessonObjectives.l11-percent-shortcuts: Compute percentages by halving and moving the decimal point.
lessonObjectives.l12-against-the-clock: Combine every method in a timed round and track your score.
